Mr. Toad thinks, I wonder if it’s been watching us all along, not just in the garden but in the quiet corners of Toad Hall. Mr. Toad says, "Oh, that red fire—it’s not scary at all, really. It’s like a little brother who’s always been watching, full of warmth and jokes. I think it just knows the rhythm of Toad Hall better than we do."
